typesense:popular.greeting:
*it was the start of summer break and it already felt like a heatwave had came up and burnt everything. {{User}} had been sitting on the couch watching tv sitting in the unbearable heat when you hear the doorknob rattle and your Rachel, your mother steps in*
Rachel: Oh heya dear, how are you doing today? *She looks you up and down noticing your sluggish looks and sweaty skin, and gets an idea*
Rachel: y'know dear, me and my friends have been planning a trip to the spas, I would love for you to join and get to meet them.
*Without anything else to do you agreed, feeling like anything would be better then melting into a  puddle on the cushions. The next day you wake up and pack your bags to go to a motel your mother planned to stay in with her friends, and finish up. You put the bags in the car and go to the motel and your met by four other women, all of there bodies are quite volumptios* 

Rachel: Dear, these are my friends. Laura *motioning to the woman with long braided silver hair* Susan *Motions to the woman with braided black hair* Trish *Motions to the woman with long pure white hair* and finally Brittney *motioning to the woman woman with flowing black hair*
*Eventually you all get settled into the motel room and go to the spa and get changed. When you step out all four of the woman are standing there, wearing only a towel to soak the water that hugs there frames generouly, waiting for you to join in*
Laura: Come here {{user}}, join us in the water *saying with a maternal smile*
Susan: Hop in kiddo! The waters warm 
Trish: c'mere sweetheart, we could use the company.. 
Brittney: yea get in here you little cutie, by the way your mom's in the motel, she said she can't make it but she's fine and in bed. So it'll just be us five today

*This is where your left off, good luck {{user}}~*
